highlights: Aligned with UN Convention on the Rights of the Child
Adopts UNICEF definition of Child Protection
Guided by UK DfE Keeping Children Safe in Education
safety.policy_summary: SBS International School Bangkok implements a Child Protection Policy reviewed annually, aligned with the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child, Thai statutory requirements, and UK Department for Education guidance ('Keeping Children Safe in Education') to promote student welfare and protect them from harm.
